data.one_liner: Fetch Firestore documents with read from cache first then server based on a timestamp field.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin designed to fetch documents and queries from Cloud Firestore by reading from the cache first and falling back or updating based on a designated timestamp field on a Firestore document.
use_when: You want to optimize Firestore read costs by serving cached data first.
You can manage timestamp fields in Firestore to signal when data updates should occur.
avoid_when: You require real-time automatic cache-to-server data comparison without managing manual timestamp fields.
You are using standard Firestore offline persistence which handles caching natively.
strengths: Helps reduce Firestore read operations by utilizing local cache first.
Integrates seamlessly with cloud_firestore and shared_preferences.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on a manually updated timestamp field to determine when to fetch from the server.
Requires extra setup steps involving creating tracking documents and fields on Firestore.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a specific document and a timestamp field in Firestore for each collection or document you want to fetch.
